Mental Health Care Plan Details

Principal Problem: Ongoing psychotropic medication use (indication unclear)
- Patient Goal(s): Clarify purpose of Seroxat and ensure effective symptom control
- Clinical Goal(s): Confirm current mental health diagnosis; review efficacy, side-effects, and necessity of Seroxat
- Actions (Patient): Maintain medication adherence; monitor mood/anxiety; record any side-effects
- Actions (Clinician/GP): Obtain detailed psychiatric history; consider PHQ-9/GAD-7 screening; review Seroxat dosage; consider referral to mental health specialist if indicated

Secondary Problem: Work-related stress and fatigue
- Patient Goal(s): Return to work feeling physically and mentally well
- Clinical Goal(s): Support sick leave during acute illness; provide stress-management resources
- Actions (Patient): Utilise recommended stress-reduction techniques; communicate with employer regarding health status
- Actions (Clinician/GP): Provide medical certificate as needed; offer information on occupational health support; consider brief counselling referral
